title: Wildfires on Greek Island
summary: Wildfires swept the Greek island of Salamina, also known as Salamis, resulting in two deaths. Hundreds of people were evacuated from the island due to the simultaneous fires. The fires occurred on the island, which is located near Athens, Greece. The exact cause of the fires is not specified in the available information. The evacuation efforts were undertaken to ensure the safety of the island's residents and visitors.
summary_points: Two people died in the wildfires on the Greek island of Salamina.
Hundreds of people were evacuated from the island due to the fires.
